title: VK-only Write Multiple Registers with seven-register payload
purpose: Exercise interaction among a seven-register quantity, fourteen-byte payload, byte count, address, and MBAP length while covering the write confirmation path associated with repeated-operation evidence.

messages.label: write seven consecutive registers with fourteen-byte payload

expected_behavior: A conforming server should parse the complete fourteen-byte register payload and return the normal Write Multiple Registers acknowledgment or a mapping-related exception response; a stateful harness may repeat the request to observe consistency.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0015 equals unit identifier plus the twenty-byte Write Multiple Registers PDU.
Quantity 0007 and byte count 0e agree, with fourteen payload bytes present.
The transaction identifier and unit identifier differ from the other candidates.
issue_safety_notes: Seven-register coverage is an analogue to the quantity reported in issue 738, while repeated-write behavior is informed by issue 279. Neither issue is claimed to be reproduced, and no exact historical crash payload is used.
